lessonTitle: 10. Signs of trigonometric functions by quadrant
lessonTitleEnglish: Signs of trigonometric functions by quadrant
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: sin α is the ordinate of P, so it is positive in quadrants I and II and negative in III and IV.
stages.headlineEnglish: sin α is the ordinate of P, so it is positive in quadrants I and II and negative in III and IV.

stages.headline: cos α is the abscissa: positive in I and IV; tg α and ctg α are positive in I and III.
